scenes.focus: exactly three separate aged wax-sealed letters arranged in a loose triangle on an old oak detective desk, with a cup of long-cold tea between them
scenes.camera: medium-close high three-quarter view of all three sealed envelopes on the single desktop, no people present
scenes.location: a modest private detective office in rainy industrial Birmingham in the 1920s
required: exactly three distinct closed wax-sealed paper envelopes spread apart across the table
one decorated porcelain teacup on its saucer next to the envelopes
weathered railway sketches and ordinary papers partly beneath the envelopes
scenes.background: brass desk lamp, dark wooden surfaces, vintage leather document case, window showing wet brick factories and smoky chimneys
scenes.light: warm amber desk lamp on paper and oak with cold blue-grey daylight through rain-streaked glass
scenes.npc: an empty office with no character faces and no hands
scenes.knowledgeBoundary: The three letters offer alternative tactics but do not establish any chosen path, confirmed evidence, deal or safety guarantee
avoid: readable names, business names, dates, exact numbers or signatures on the envelopes
a chosen or completed investigation outcome
new evidence asserted as proven or witnesses already protected

scenes.focus: a resolute woman newspaper editor seen from behind presses her ink-marked palm firmly on a newspaper proof and pushes the sheet away from a visitor holding papers
scenes.camera: intimate medium low three-quarter view over the woman's shoulder at the same editorial worktable; the visitor is a cropped dark coat and hand at frame edge
scenes.location: a cramped 1920s Birmingham newspaper editorial room with an antique printing press
required: female editor's ink-smudged hand planted on a partially curled proof sheet, pushing it away
heavy old iron letterpress with a large turning wheel and a wooden tray of metal type
visitor's dark coat sleeve and a small stack of ordinary papers in the near foreground
scenes.background: worn wooden editorial desk, cast iron ink roller, stacks of loose unprinted papers, teacup, rain-streaked window overlooking brick industrial buildings
scenes.light: amber oil lamp over the desk with cool rainy light through a high window
scenes.npc: one woman with her dark hair pinned back, seen from behind with face concealed, and one visitor whose face remains out of frame
scenes.knowledgeBoundary: This editorial refusal establishes a conversation, not a published report, an independently verified evidence chain or protected witnesses
avoid: a readable headline declaring a casualty count
published allegations or identifiable witness names
a new face for the established editor or the playable detective
a completed public investigation or triumphant publication
